reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 21. Nay or No: 19. Not Voting: 0. said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
A nationwide groundstop of aircraft is an unprecedented and deeply concerning disruption that puts our entire nation at risk. We need answers from the Trump administration as to what went wrong, and the immediate steps being taken to prevent this from happening again.

https://t.co/pn5mjvbrU6

Today, we honor the men and women who protect our country every day. Their courage and selfless sacrifices help keep our nation safe, and their service is something we will always be grateful for.

To all who have served, thank you for your dedication, your sacrifice, and your https://t.co/A4ZU7rx7NB

We made Big Bend a national park because some places are worth protecting for generations. That includes protecting it from Donald Trump’s border wall. Leave @BigBendNPS alone. https://t.co/RNnqFPrybQ

Are you registered to vote? If you are unsure, you may be able to cast a provisional ballot.  Learn more at https://t.co/bwrjOMDuyR for more information and specific eligibility. https://t.co/eCwQSkitaC
🚨Today is Election Day, Texas!🚨 This is the last chance to cast your ballot in person. Polls are open 7am to 7pm! https://t.co/J6LaqcmhZN

Texans are waking up. The President’s illegal war in Iran is recklessly making life harder for our state and our country. Texans need leadership that puts their well-being first, not a war that leaves them paying for the price tag.

https://t.co/hIzrdQOLFA
🚨Texas Voters🚨Today is the last day for in person, early voting. Polls are open 7am-7pm! https://t.co/kAswjRhoKH

Grateful to be presented the Texas Health Resources for the 2026 Excellence in Public Service Award. 

From authoring Texas' first bipartisan Medicaid expansion bill to fighting for the ACA tax credits nearly 100,000 of my constituents rely on, health care has been at the center https://t.co/ncve0tfRQk

Dolores Huerta fought for our country's farmworkers and helped generations of women recognize their own power. America is better because she refused to back down.

Rest in power, Dolores. Sí, se puede. https://t.co/hL9bPGKDzd

Thousands of Americans become our everyday heroes, responding to crises, saving lives, and protecting communities. On this National First Responders Day, we send our gratitude to the people that take on some of the most dangerous jobs in our country and remember those who gave their lives to keep us safe.

Today is the last day to submit your app idea to the @CongressionalAC! To register your idea, and to check eligibility and app parameters, check out our website. Happy coding! 

https://t.co/OxBO5pjo04

Despite the relentless attacks against the LGBTQ+ community from President Trump and Republicans, I never backed down from defending our community and protecting our rights.

I’m proud to have received this perfect voting score from @HRC, because our community deserves leaders with a backbone.

posts.text:
🚨Texas Voters🚨 Did you know you can track your ballot using https://t.co/1UqhL5rcQy’s Ballot By Mail tracker? 

After entering in your voter-specific information, you’ll be able to check if your ballot has been accepted by your county’s Early Voting Clerk. To have your mail-in ballot counted, it must be postmarked by 7:00pm on November 3rd. 

https://t.co/owFAqM7l87

Team Johnson recently celebrated the grand opening of the new Esperanza Community Center! This former school has been transformed into a state-of-the-art facility that brings afterschool programs, adult education, and workforce development resources together under one roof! https://t.co/XSgpLEBhR4
President Trump is letting Russia decide when and how their own sanctions are applied. Our allies are suffering because the President is once again cozying up to a dictator. https://t.co/kuIcHQqPd4

In person, early voting begins today, Texas! Check out https://t.co/jOh7z0MCgR to find your local polling center and be sure to have a valid form of voter ID to get your ballot. Every vote matters, so make your voice heard! https://t.co/OP0wIS6Itu

This was a despicable act by a white supremacist that was looking to inflict harm on Indian Americans. I’m grateful that @CongressmanRaja and his family are safe, but incidents like this shouldn’t be a normal occurrence in the United States. We must stand together against hate and protect the fundamental right of every American to practice their religion freely and without fear.

ICE agents have terrorized our communities for long enough. Time and time again, they’ve shown us they’re willing to break the law and evade accountability simply because this administration says they can. Dallas won't let them operate in the shadows, and neither should Congress.

The 500,000 voter application backlog shouldn’t have happened in the first place- let alone this close to an election. Voters deserve answers about how this happened and what’s being done to ensure it never happens again. https://t.co/DjoZBccKZt

On this day in 1792, the cornerstone of the White House was laid.

For 230+ years, it has stood as a symbol of the American presidency. Now Trump is tearing into that history to build himself a massive ballroom.

George Washington laid the foundation for the presidency. Trump wants to leave behind a monument to his own ego.

The Texas story begins with its Indigenous peoples.

For thousands of years, Indigenous peoples shaped this land, from its earliest communities and trade routes to the art, craftsmanship, and traditions that helped define Texas culture.

On Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we honor that history and recognize the Native Texans whose cultures remain a living part of our state’s heritage.

College applications can get expensive fast. Next week, Texas students can cross those fees off the list! October 12–18 is Texas Free College Application Week, and application fees are waived at public colleges and universities across the state.

That’s one less expense standing between you and your next big step. Take advantage of it at https://t.co/vNx9ASFSPw!

https://t.co/5rD6CMMJR6

Dallas and Denton counties: @TXGLO  is hosting a disaster relief program this Saturday for homeowners affected by the federally designated disasters in 2024. Check the link below to learn more about how you can qualify for aid! 

https://t.co/4PfZXmBr58

Three years after the horrific terrorist attack on Israel, we remember the victims and their families whose lives were forever changed on this day. While war rages on in the region, we also cannot forget the devastation that has occurred in Gaza and the West Bank. It is time for peace, diplomacy, and an end to this ongoing violence in the Middle East that President Trump has egged on with his illegal war in Iran and continued support for Israel's offensive weaponry.
We’re STILL waiting to hear back from election officials about how to solve the voter registration backlog. Read more here: https://t.co/jlI7MDd2eO

Due to the monumental backlog of voter registrations, Texas election officials are calling recent updates to the state’s voter registration system a ‘systematic failure’. State Republicans have sewn chaos into Texas' electoral system just weeks before a crucial election. https://t.co/AI49yt3LKP

October is LGBTQ+ History Month. From Stonewall riots to Obergefell, we're celebrating the voices, stories, and contributions that have helped shape our communities and continue to inspire future generations. Our history often goes overlooked, but its impact is felt worldwide. https://t.co/uHMPGcIJJ4

posts.text:
Big win for Big Bend: A U.S. District Judge has haulted all border wall construction through our national treasure. Big Bend belongs to the American people, not a construction crew. Protecting our border should never mean destroying the land that makes Texas extraordinary.

https://t.co/eeZbs4Co06

TEXAS VOTERS: TODAY is the last day to register to vote in Nov.

Even if you THINK you’re registered, CHECK YOUR STATUS. More than 1.2 million Texas voters are on the voter suspense list, and you could be one of them without realizing it.

Visit https://t.co/Q6aTYowAb0 to check your registration ASAP.

Don’t wait until it's too late to discover you've got a problem.
This October, we stand with survivors. We must work together to make ensure everyone in our communities feels safe, heard, and respected. https://t.co/HGqtl4tSJe

DHS just admitted in court that they’re starting border construction AGAIN in @BigBendNPS. We stood united the first time against this despicable decision, and we’ll do it again. Big Bend belongs to Texas. https://t.co/q1QvWEVQm7
https://t.co/f9gjUsJBzF

As President Trump and Pete Hegseth order our armed services to violate our laws and ignore our Constitution, I’m working to make sure we have a backstop in place for service members who are "just following orders". I recently introduced the Enduring Accountability Act to make sure unlawful orders still has consequences.
Read more about the bill below 👇

Texas voters: October brings several important election deadlines. Be sure to check your voter registration status and make a plan to cast your ballot. 

Make sure you’re ready before the deadlines arrive! https://t.co/u33xuFdJdh

Fifty years of Hyde is fifty years too long. No one should be forced to carry a pregnancy against their will because politicians decided abortion care should be treated differently from other pregnancy-related healthcare.

It’s time to end coverage bans. #Hyde50 

https://t.co/ald99JvZER

From Big Bend to Big Thicket, Texas’s national lands showcase some of the most diverse and breathtaking landscapes in the country. On National Public Lands Day, we celebrate these special places and our shared responsibility to protect them for generations to come. https://t.co/238RuAZr0a

To see if you're one of the Texans who may have been impacted, check your voter registration here: https://t.co/YaP1ZcU4u7 
3/3
Click here read my full letter to DPS: https://t.co/jlI7MDdA4m 2/3

Just two weeks before a critical election deadline, Greg Abbott and Texas Republicans are manipulating Texas Elections again. The Texas Department of Public Safety announced a massive voter registration backlog, potentially delaying ballots and stripping voters of their voices. 100k applications are estimated to be held up in Dallas and Collin Counties alone. Here’s how I'm taking urgent action. 1/3

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
